Few places in the world can match the allure of Kuwait. Whether you are planning a trip to Kuwait for the first time or returning for more, there is always something new to discover.

## Best Time to Visit

The ideal time to explore Kuwait depends on what you want to experience. Spring brings mild weather and blooming landscapes.

## Top Attractions

- Famous attractions that define Kuwait
- Hidden gems only locals know about
- Natural sites that tell the story of Kuwait
- Scenic viewpoints for unforgettable photos

![Kuwait landscape](https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1558634742-56096b49522b?fm=webp&w=1200&q=60)

## Local Cuisine

No trip to Kuwait is complete without sampling the local food. From street-side vendors to fine dining establishments, the culinary scene reflects the region's rich heritage and innovative spirit.

## Getting Around

Renting a vehicle gives you the freedom to discover Kuwait at your own pace, especially for remote attractions.

## Where to Stay

Luxury resorts and budget hostels coexist in Kuwait, giving travelers plenty of options.
